Task.title: Task
Task.description: A work project, academic exam, or daily life task managed by the user.

ownerId.description: The authenticated Firebase UID of the task owner.

title.description: Primary title of the project, exam, or daily task.

subtitle.description: Client, subject, course, or personal context label.

category.description: Area classification: trabajo, examen, or diario.

status.description: Board workflow column: pendiente, en_marcha, or terminado.

tag.description: Short phase or status badge text.

totalSubtasks.description: Total count of subtasks from 0 to 50.

completedSubtasks.description: Count of completed subtasks from 0 to 50.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the task was last updated.

Subtask.title: Subtask
Subtask.description: An actionable checklist step or exam topic belonging to a parent Task.

ownerId.description: The authenticated Firebase UID of the subtask owner.

taskId.description: Document ID of the parent Task in /tasks/{taskId}.

title.description: Step description or study topic title.

completed.description: Whether the subtask has been completed.

scheduleLabel.description: Optional timing cue such as En curso, Hoy, or Mañana.

sortOrder.description: Display order index within the parent task.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the subtask was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the subtask was last updated.

/tasks/{taskId}.description: Stores user tasks, academic exams, and work projects.

/subtasks/{subtaskId}.description: Stores individual checklist steps linked to a parent task.
